productionProvisioning.approvalNote: Production Railway services, stores, variables, provider routes, and Bifrost ingress must not be provisioned or enabled until explicit Track 0 production approval is recorded.

development.notes: Development variables may use Railway reference variables and inert placeholder values. Live provider calls remain gated by registry, policy, and eval controls.

production.notes: Production variables are defined here for review only. Provisioning and deploys are disabled until explicit release approval.

defaults.secretStorage: Railway environment variables or Railway service reference variables only; no real secrets in source control.
defaults.nonSecretStorage: Railway environment variables, reviewed docs, or generated config where appropriate.

groups.productionGate: Better Auth production origin, admin TOTP, invite-only bootstrap, and auth smoke tests must be approved before production use.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
variables.rotation: Update when the Control API domain changes; verify trusted origins and auth smoke tests.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
variables.rotation: Rotate through Railway variables during a maintenance window; invalidate affected sessions if the auth implementation requires it.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
variables.rotation: Review whenever portal or API domains change.

variables.name: AUTH_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED
variables.rotation: Keep false except for a time-boxed approved bootstrap; reset immediately after bootstrap.

variables.name: AUTH_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL
variables.rotation: Change only through approved admin ownership transfer.

groups.productionGate: Operational and Knowledge Postgres must have migration policy, least-privilege roles, backup/restore validation, and db checks before production.

variables.name: OPERATIONAL_DATABASE_URL
variables.rotation: Use Railway managed Postgres credential rotation or recreate scoped role; update dependent services atomically.

variables.name: KNOWLEDGE_DATABASE_URL
variables.rotation: Rotate with Knowledge Postgres role credentials and rerun retrieval/indexer connectivity checks.

variables.name: DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL
variables.rotation: Rotate after every production migration role change and after suspected exposure; migration role must not be used by request-serving services.

variables.name: DATABASE_READONLY_URL
variables.rotation: Rotate with read-only role grants; verify dashboards and read-only tools reconnect.

groups.productionGate: Redis queues, locks, and rate-limit namespaces must be isolated by environment before production.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.rotation: Rotate through Railway Redis credentials; restart queue workers and API services after update.

variables.name: REDIS_QUEUE_NAMESPACE
variables.rotation: Change only during planned queue migration; drain old queues first.

variables.name: REDIS_RATE_LIMIT_NAMESPACE
variables.rotation: Change with rate-limit policy deployment; old counters can expire naturally.

groups.productionGate: Bifrost route config must be generated or validated from a registry snapshot with passing eval gates; stale or missing policy/registry versions fail closed.

variables.name: BIFROST_BASE_URL
variables.rotation: Update when the Bifrost Railway domain changes; verify IDE gateway clients and Control API route metadata.

variables.name: BIFROST_ADMIN_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate after any admin access change, break-glass event, or suspected exposure.

variables.name: BIFROST_VIRTUAL_KEY_SEED
variables.rotation: Rotate by issuing new virtual keys, revoking old keys, and auditing active sessions.

variables.name: BIFROST_CONFIG_PATH
variables.rotation: Host-side DevGateway evidence artifact path; change only with reviewed config evidence strategy.

variables.name: BIFROST_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH
variables.rotation: Host-side upstream Bifrost runtime config artifact path; must be generated/validated separately from DevGateway evidence.

variables.name: BIFROST_CONTAINER_CONFIG_PATH
variables.rotation: Container mount target; upstream Bifrost reads <app-dir>/config.json.

variables.name: BIFROST_ROUTE_CONFIG_VERSION
variables.rotation: Update on every approved registry snapshot; startup must validate the version before accepting traffic.

variables.name: BIFROST_POLICY_VERSION
variables.rotation: Update with provider/data-class policy releases; reject requests carrying stale or mismatched policy versions.

variables.name: BIFROST_POLICY_MAX_STALENESS_SECONDS
variables.rotation: Reserved for future live-sync pipelines with runtime sync timestamps; do not seed as an active default for immutable checked-in snapshots.

variables.name: BIFROST_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED
variables.rotation: Keep false except during approved break-glass TTL; reset and rotate provider keys after use.

variables.name: DEVGATEWAY_OPENAI_API_KEY_PLACEHOLDER
variables.rotation: Placeholder/reference only until provider gates pass; do not expose literal OPENAI_API_KEY to Bifrost before validated config gates provider enablement.

variables.name: DEVGATEWAY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_PLACEHOLDER
variables.rotation: Placeholder/reference only until provider gates pass; do not expose literal ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to Bifrost before validated config gates provider enablement.

groups.productionGate: GitHub App scopes, webhook validation, installation ownership, and stale-sync default-deny rules must pass policy validation before production.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
variables.rotation: Update only when replacing the GitHub App; revalidate permissions and webhooks.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID
variables.rotation: Update when installation scope changes; force permission resync.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64
variables.rotation: Rotate through GitHub App private key lifecycle and Railway variable update; revoke old key after rollout.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.rotation: Rotate with webhook secret change; accept dual secrets only during a short approved transition.

groups.productionGate: Artifact, source snapshot, generated document, and trace-bundle buckets must have backup/restore and least-privilege access reviewed.

variables.name: S3_ENDPOINT
variables.rotation: Update when bucket provider or Railway bucket endpoint changes.

variables.name: S3_BUCKET
variables.rotation: Change only with a migration or restore plan.

variables.name: S3_REGION
variables.rotation: Update if bucket region changes; verify data residency policy.

variables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.rotation: Rotate with object-storage credentials; verify workers, eval runner, and trace exporters.

variables.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate with object-storage credentials; revoke old key after all services are updated.

variables.name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
variables.rotation: Change only when switching object-storage provider compatibility mode.

groups.productionGate: OpenTelemetry Collector, Prometheus, Grafana, trace retention, and dashboard ownership must be reviewed before production.

variables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
variables.rotation: Update when collector endpoint changes; verify telemetry ingestion.

variables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
variables.rotation: Rotate collector authentication headers on schedule and after exposure.

variables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
variables.rotation: Change with service rename; keep dashboards synchronized.

variables.name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
variables.rotation: Review with telemetry taxonomy changes.

variables.name: TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE
variables.rotation: Tune through observability review; production changes must preserve audit and incident needs.

variables.name: METRICS_EXPORT_MODE
variables.rotation: Change when Prometheus/OTel topology changes.

groups.productionGate: Production route, alias, prompt, retrieval, tool, skill, and index changes require matching passing eval gate results.

variables.name: EVAL_DATASET_PATH
variables.rotation: Update when dataset layout changes; validators must pass.

variables.name: EVAL_GATE_MODE
variables.rotation: Production cannot use fixture-only gates for real enablement; mode changes require Evaluation owner approval.

variables.name: EVAL_ARTIFACT_BUCKET
variables.rotation: Change with object-storage migration and gate-result retention review.

variables.name: EVAL_PROVIDER_MODE
variables.rotation: Live provider mode requires approved provider policy and gate controls.

variables.name: EVAL_SMOKE_ENABLED
variables.rotation: Keep true for readiness checks; disabling requires release approval.

groups.productionGate: Application encryption, credential key versioning, rotation control, and audit correlation must be approved before production provider credentials are stored.

variables.name: APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_BASE64
variables.rotation: Rotate through key-versioned credential re-encryption; never commit raw key material.

variables.name: CREDENTIAL_KEY_VERSION
variables.rotation: Increment with each credential encryption key rollout.

variables.name: CREDENTIAL_ROTATION_REQUIRED
variables.rotation: Set true after suspected exposure, break-glass provider-key use, or scheduled rotation trigger; clear after verification.

variables.name: AUDIT_CORRELATION_SALT
variables.rotation: Rotate only with audit correlation impact review; preserve ability to investigate historical events.
